! Game text
| Target two starfighters at same system (one Rebel, one Imperial). Each player draws destiny. Opponent totals destiny and starship's power. You total destiny, starship's power and starship's maneuver. Lowest total immediately loses starfighter. || Target two starfighters {{Errata hl|(your TIE/ln and any Rebel starfighter) present at same system or sector}}. Each player draws destiny. Opponent totals destiny and starship's power. You total destiny, {{Errata hl|TIE's}} power and {{Errata hl|TIE's}} maneuver. Lowest total {{Errata hl|loses}} starfighter.
